details: Open Contents to inspect the checklist rules if useful.
The skill must not infer a price or a confirmed visit.

skills.name: estimate-visit-brief
skills.description: Prepare a dispatch brief from confirmed estimate notes. Preserve contact details, visit time and source references.
skills.instructions: Read the supplied visit notes. Extract the customer, appointment and access instructions. Cite the source file next to each fact. If a required fact is absent, list it as missing. Do not infer prices or mark the visit confirmed without an explicit confirmation.

scenes.title: A brief with the missing detail flagged.
scenes.caption: The draft preserves Thursday at 2 PM and the gate note. The address stays on hold for confirmation.
scenes.beat: The brief keeps the confirmed time and gate note, and flags the missing address.
details: Point to Thursday at 2 PM and the open side gate, with source filenames.
Show Property address: not provided before moving to the call ask.
